change: Admit ordinary window COUNT(VARBINARY, day-time intervals, year-month intervals) through existing validity-only kernels; no production Rust change or opt-in.
boundary: Production Flink Java/RowData operator versus production Rust/Arrow core. Equivalent values, cardinalities, NULLs, output fields and first-batch state prefix; setup/import/export/perimeter transposes outside timing. Includes update/state/accounting/final watermark flush and output consumption.
limitations: Final-watermark operator benchmark; no checkpoint I/O, periodic-watermark or whole-job throughput claim.
Previous admission rejected these ordinary COUNT types and used stock fallback; these measurements compare stock operation, not an independently timed previous complete runtime.
Fixed BINARY, DISTINCT and value-interpreting interval/binary aggregates remain separate.
validation_note: The shared Cargo target initially reused the session-only example. Recompiling the current count example by refreshing its source timestamp produced the frozen driver used for the final Flink1.18 parity cohort; that failed no-output attempt is excluded from timing claims.
